content:
For untagged legacy CORE source lots, EXPORT can fund USD payments or conversion with valid quota; IMPORT and SERVICES cannot be converted. Lots tagged MARKET_A, MARKET_B, SERVICE, CAPITAL or REIMBURSEMENT instead use the source_routes policy and SOURCE-* schedules.

Conversion permission and beneficiary-channel permission are separate properties. Fees are taken from the independent fee wallet; principal remains in its source lots until consumed.
